schema.title: JSON schema for JasmineNodeTestAdapter configuration files (JasmineNodeTestAdapter.json)

Name.description: The name of the test container.

BasePath.description: The base path to use to resolve file paths. Defaults to the directory in which JasmineNodeTestAdapter.json resides.

Helpers.description: Non-source, non-spec helper files. Loaded before any specs. Wildcards can be used - see [glob](https://www.npmjs.com/package/glob).

Specs.description: Files containing Jasmine specs. Wildcards can be used - see [glob](https://www.npmjs.com/package/glob).

Watch.description: A test run is triggered if any file specified in `Helpers` or `Specs` change. Add any files in `Watch` that should also trigger a test run when they change. These will typically be the source files. Wildcards can be used - see [glob](https://www.npmjs.com/package/glob).

BatchInterval.description: When the test adapter is watching files for changes, it will wait `BatchInterval` ms before running tests. Default value is 250.

Traits.description: Traits to attach to each test.

Extensions.description: Path to a node.js module implementing extensions.

Disabled.description: Set to true, if the test adapter should be disabled for this configuration file.

LogToFile.description: Set to true, if you want the adapter to write log statements to a log file (named JasmineNodeTestAdapter.log).

LogDirectory.description: Where the log file should be saved (if LogToFile is true). If this property is not specified the directory in which JasmineNodeTestAdapter.json resides is used.

description:
The test suite is defined by the Jasmine Node test adapter configuration located at https://example.com/schemas/JasmineNodeTestAdapter.json and is named **MyProjectTests**. Its base directory is `./test`; all helper files are pulled from the glob pattern `test/helpers/**/*.js` and are loaded before any specs. The actual spec files are matched by `test/spec/**/*.spec.js`, while source changes that should trigger a re‑run are watched under `src/**/*.js`. When a change is detected the adapter waits 300 ms (the BatchInterval) before executing the tests.

Two traits are attached to each test: a simple tag **smoke** and a key/value pair **Priority = High**. The configuration points to a custom extensions module at `./extensions/customAdapter.js`. The adapter is enabled (Disabled = false), and logging is active – logs will be written to a file in the `./logs` directory (LogToFile = true, LogDirectory = `./logs`).
